architecture.track_resolved: six ERA5-matched literature catalogues reconciled into canonical track-time records
architecture.event_resolved: Farjami & Kazemi (2024) Southern Ocean event snapshots, kept separate because only day-level event records are supplied
architecture.validation: IMPMCT and Rojo raw satellite positions

important_limitation: HAPLoD is a harmonized reference database, not a uniformly detected climatology. Track-resolved and event-resolved layers must not be pooled as exchangeable samples.
